data.assumption: “Average order” means all non-test orders from showrooms in India, with the value calculated as non-test payment attempts divided by orders, including orders with zero payment attempts.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(pa.attempt_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS value
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
LEFT JOIN payment_attempts pa ON pa.order_id = o.order_id AND pa.is_test = false
WHERE o.is_test = false
  AND c.name = 'India'
